body.prose:
A mount is a component and what it is given, its argument: one holon, or a list of them. At the place of a brief it is always one brief; only a value that truly is a list is drawn as a list, by the list component.

*The author's, 2026-11-03: for the location of a brief it is always just one brief, unless it truly is an array, and then naturally a list. The mount as a call OpenLight's.*
body.title: A mount is a call
